Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient department in the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden). It reports its clinical data to the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] [^src2]. The clinic is evaluated on national quality indicators for ADHD assessment and treatment in child and adolescent psychiatry.

In the 2023/24 reporting period, the clinic achieved a 60% fulfillment rate for quality indicator 2a, which measures the proportion of ADHD assessments for children aged 0–5 that include a clinical environmental observation within 120 days [^src1]. Out of 123 cases, 74 met this standard [^src1]. While this falls short of the national standard of ≥90%, it is above the regional average for the Capital Region, indicating a relatively stable practice in clinical environmental observation compared to other local departments [^src1].

Furthermore, in the 2024 national ADHD report covering the period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025, the clinic (listed as B29) reported a medication rate of 68% for [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]], which tracks pharmacological treatment [^src2]. This data contributes to the broader evaluation of diagnostic and treatment practices, highlighting systemic challenges and regional variations in the Danish ADHD intervention framework [^src1] [^src2].
